title_zh: 五数据集固定评测标准
ownership: Project-defined shared standard; upstream dataset ownership and licenses remain unchanged.
change_policy: Immutable v1: changes to membership, order, source revisions, budgets, scoring, tokenizer or metrics require a new version. Never silently resample or relabel historical results.

datasets.name: MMLU-Pro
datasets.selection_zh: 沿用原包固定 200 题及顺序，覆盖 14 学科；不重新抽样。
datasets.selection_en: Reuse the frozen 200 cases and order across 14 subjects.

datasets.name: HLE-Verified
datasets.selection_zh: Gold 文本 64 / 图像 10；Revision 文本 113 / 图像 13。按比例分配后，层内确定性系统抽样。
datasets.selection_en: Gold text/image 64/10; Revision text/image 113/13. Proportional allocation followed by deterministic systematic selection.

datasets.name: FrontierScience
datasets.selection_zh: 固定版本 Olympiad 100 + Research 60，保留全部题目及原始顺序。
datasets.selection_en: All 100 Olympiad and 60 Research cases at the pinned revision.

datasets.name: SWE-bench Pro public traces
datasets.selection_zh: 官方公开轨迹：按仓库分层固定 32 任务，每任务首尾各一条有效请求；原数据缺失 94 任务。
datasets.selection_en: Official public trajectories: 32 repository-stratified tasks, first/last eligible requests; 94 source tasks unavailable.

datasets.name: Terminal-Bench 2.1 public traces
datasets.selection_zh: 公开作者抓取的原始请求：匹配 2.1 任务后固定 32 任务；16 任务仅一条有效请求，不补齐或复制。
datasets.selection_en: Author-published raw requests: 32 frozen tasks matching 2.1; 16 tasks have one eligible request. No duplication.

execution.access: Reference engine tools require private repository access; public protocols do not grant dataset, engine or redistribution rights.
execution.engine_binding: Record actual baseline/candidate/model/hardware independently for every campaign. This workload standard does not replace either project runtime or baseline contracts.
execution.trace_model_binding: Trace token IDs and 16K eligibility are frozen for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16 tokenizer files in the trace protocol. Another tokenizer/model requires a new profile, not silent recalc.
execution.judge: HLE and Frontier use one identical frozen judge for both arms; record model, actual runtime, prompts, parser and budgets. Judge traffic is excluded from solver performance and cost.

metrics.throughput: Accepted generated output tokens divided by whole solver batch wall time, first request submission to last response completion; never sum overlapping durations.
metrics.ttft: Per-request submission to first content-token event; retain raw SSE and timestamps.
metrics.tpot: Per request (response completion - first content-token event)/(output_tokens - 1), defined only for output_tokens > 1; report excluded metric count. Mean gives each defined request equal weight.
metrics.percentiles: Finite-sample linear interpolation at (n-1)*q; report sample count. Finite batches do not establish continuous 16K P95/P99 stability.
metrics.quality: Use unchanged per-dataset graders and planned denominators. Report each HLE stratum and Frontier track. Errors, missing answers, truncation and unresolved judges remain visible.
metrics.trace_quality: Not measured: no task execution, completion rate, solve rate or historical author scores.

invariants: Exact same frozen tasks, request order, prompt content and generation budgets for both arms; no outcome-based filtering, retries, padding or task replacement.
Preserve EOS; no force-length decode or silent short-output fallback. Preserve original trace histories/tools as inputs, tool_choice=none; execute no historical commands.
Trace generation uses fresh cache_salt and zero KV reuse; both arms must pass /tokenize with identical frozen token ID hashes before generation.
Historical trace timestamps are provenance only; concurrency8 closed-loop batch is not historical arrival replay.
Publish protocol, input identity and actual execution identity separately. A frozen plan or CPU check is not a completed model experiment.
Quality subsets do not establish population equivalence, full official leaderboard replication or all four acceptance targets. Continuous 4K/16K C8 and four-target gates remain separate.

licensing.raw_questions_answers: Not redistributed in this bundle; restore from original sources subject to their terms.
licensing.raw_terminal_traces: Author-published research-only capture; runtime fetches pinned original source bytes into user cache. No raw conversations distributed here.
licensing.raw_swe_traces: Restore public original trajectories with source license; no raw conversations distributed here.
licensing.swe_tool_schema: Official SWE-agent 1.1.0 tool schemas and MIT license retained in swe-agent-v110-tools.json.

results: No benchmark scores or performance measurements are included. Adoption does not retroactively certify earlier experiments.
